title: Camplora 8 x 227 g Butane Gas Cartridges with MSF-1a Valve
short_description: Camplora butane gas cartridges, 8-pack with 227 g each and an MSF-1a valve — for camping and compatible outdoor stoves.
long_description: According to Amazon, the Camplora set contains 8 gas cartridges with 227 g of butane gas each and an MSF-1a valve (part number 7000-022-008). The package measures 30 x 22 x 16 cm and weighs 2.7 kg according to Amazon. Please check on the Amazon product page before buying whether the MSF-1a valve fits your stove or device. Also note the safety information on the Amazon page and on the cartridges. Gas cartridges are flammable and must be stored and transported safely.
buying_angle: Handy for campers who need a supply of butane cartridges for a stove with a matching MSF-1a connection.
